properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws$/
| fields @timestamp, resourcePath, responseLatency, status, httpMethod
| filter isPresent(httpMethod) AND isPresent(status)
| stats count(*) as cantidadReq
properties.title: TotalRequest

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws$/
| fields @timestamp, resourcePath, responseLatency, status, httpMethod
| filter isPresent(httpMethod) AND isPresent(status)
| stats (sum(status >= 200 AND status < 300) * 100 / count(*)) as value
properties.title: % HTTP 2XX

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws$/
| fields @timestamp, resourcePath, responseLatency, status, httpMethod
| filter isPresent(httpMethod) AND isPresent(status)
| stats (sum(status >= 400 AND status < 500) * 100 / count(*)) as value
properties.title: % HTTP 4XX

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws$/
| fields @timestamp, resourcePath, responseLatency, status, httpMethod
| filter isPresent(httpMethod) AND isPresent(status)
| stats (sum(status >= 500) * 100 / count(*)) as value

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws$/
| fields @timestamp, resourcePath, responseLatency, status, httpMethod
| filter isPresent(httpMethod) AND isPresent(status)
| stats pct(responseLatency, 95) as pct95
properties.title: PCT95 latencia (ms)

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws$/
| fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log,responseLatency,status
|display  status >= 200 AND status < 300 as code200 ,status >=500 as code500 , status >=400 and status <500 as code400 
|filter isPresent(status)
|stats sum( code200) AS code2xx , sum(code500) as code5xx , sum (code400) as code4xx, COUNT(*) AS totalRQ  by datefloor (@timestamp , 1m) as fecha
| sort fecha desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: STATUS CODE API

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws$/
| fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log,responseLatency,status
|filter isPresent(responseLatency)
|stats pct (responseLatency,95) AS PCT95 , avg (responseLatency) as promedio  by datefloor (@timestamp , 1m) as fecha
| sort fecha desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: LATENCIA API

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/api/api_PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws$/
| fields @log, resourcePath, responseLatency, status, httpMethod
| filter isPresent(httpMethod) AND isPresent(status)
| stats count(*) as cantidadReq,
    sum(status < 300) as status2xx,
    sum(status >= 400 and status < 500) as status4xx,
    sum(status >= 500) as status5xx,
    (sum(status >= 400) * 100 / count(*)) as pctErrorHttp,
    avg(responseLatency) as LatenciaPromedio,
    pct(responseLatency, 95) as LatenciaPct95
  by resourcePath, httpMethod
| sort status5xx desc, status4xx desc, cantidadReq desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: APIs Overview

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-(stratus|iseries|postilion)-adapter$/
| fields @timestamp, @message, @log
| filter @message like "::AUDIT::RESP::"
| parse @message /::HTTPCODE::(?<codigo>\d+)/
| parse @message /::HTTPCODE::(?<ok>200)\b/
| parse @message /::HTTPCODE::(?<negocio>412)\b/
| stats count(ok) as ok_200, count(negocio) as negocio_412, (count(*) - count(ok) - count(negocio)) as error by datefloor(@timestamp, 1m) as fecha

properties.title: RESPUESTAS ADAPTADOR EN EL TIEMPO

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-(stratus|iseries|postilion)-adapter$/
| fields @timestamp, @message, @log
| filter @message like "::AUDIT::RESP::"
| parse @message /::HTTPCODE::(?<codigo>\d+)/
| parse @message /::HTTPCODE::(?<ok>200)\b/
| parse @message /::HTTPCODE::(?<negocio>412)\b/
| parse @message /X-RqUid=(?<rquid>[0-9a-f-]+)/
| parse @message /X-Name=(?<canal>[^,\]]+)/
| parse @message /X-Referer=[^-,]+-[^-,]+-[^-,]+-(?<servicio>[^-,\]]+)/
| parse @message /"code":"(?<errorCodigo>[^"]*)"/
| parse @message /"message":"(?<errorMensaje>[^"]*)"/
| parse @message /"system":"(?<sistema>[^"]*)"/
| stats count(*) as respuestas, count(ok) as ok_200, count(negocio) as negocio_412, (count(*) - count(ok) - count(negocio)) as error,
    ((count(*) - count(ok) - count(negocio)) * 100 / count(*)) as pctError by servicio
| sort error desc, respuestas desc
| limit 200
properties.title: RESPUESTAS ADAPTADOR POR SERVICIO

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-(stratus|iseries|postilion)-adapter$/
| fields @timestamp, @message, @log

| parse @message /::HTTPCODE::(?<codigo>\d+)/

| parse @message /X-Name=(?<canal>[^,\]]+)/
| parse @message /X-Referer=[^-,]+-[^-,]+-[^-,]+-(?<servicio>[^-,\]]+)/
| parse @message /"code":"(?<errorCodigo>[^"]*)"/

| parse @message /"system":"(?<sistema>[^"]*)"/

| sort CantReq desc
| limit 1000

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-(stratus|iseries|postilion)-adapter$/
| fields @message
| filter @message like /GenericExceptionMapper/ and @message like /HttpCode::/
| parse @message /Exception:\s*(?<codigo>\d+)\s*::\s*(?<mensaje>[^.]*[^.\s])/
| parse @message /3=(?<campo>[A-Za-z0-9_.]+)\s*::HEAD::/
| parse @message /X-Referer=[^-,]+-[^-,]+-[^-,]+-(?<service>[^-,\]]+)/
| parse @message /X-Name=(?<channel>[^,\]]+)/
| stats count(*) as total by codigo, mensaje, campo, service, channel
| sort total desc
| limit 1000
properties.title: ERRORES DE MAPEO

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-mngr$/
| fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like "[ERROR !]"
| stats COUNT(*) AS total_errors  by datefloor (@timestamp , 1m) AS fecha
| limit 10000
properties.title: ERROR LOGS

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-mngr$/
| fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like "[ERROR !]"
| parse @message "* ERROR *" as date, full_details
| parse full_details "[*][*]*" as uuid_opcinal, canal_raw, msg_raw
| fields if(isPresent(canal_raw), canal_raw, "--") as canal,
         if(isPresent(msg_raw), msg_raw, full_details) as message
| stats COUNT(*) AS total_errors BY canal, message
| sort total_errors desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: RESUMEN ERRORES POR CANAL

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-mngr$/
| fields @message
| filter @message like 'ERROR'
| parse @message /<nombreOperacion>(?<nombreOperacion>[^<]+)<\/nombreOperacion>/
| parse @message /<msgRespuesta>(?<msgRespuesta>[^<]+)<\/msgRespuesta>/
| parse @message /<codMsgRespuesta>(?<codMsgRespuesta>[^<]+)<\/codMsgRespuesta>/
| filter isPresent(msgRespuesta)
| stats count(*) as CantidadErrores by nombreOperacion, codMsgRespuesta, msgRespuesta
| sort CantidadErrores desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: ERRORES POR OPERACIÓN / RESPUESTA

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-mngr$/
| fields @timestamp, @message, @logStream, @log
|filter @message LIKE "RSOUT" 
|PARSE @message "dt.trace_id=*" AS traceid
|PARSE @message "1=*" as statusCode
| parse @message /\(executor-thread-\d+\) \[(?<var1>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<canal>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<var3>[^\]]+)\]\[(?<var4>[^\]]+)\]/
| parse @message /RSOUT Servicio\s*(?<rsin_servicio>\S+)/
|display rsin_servicio,canal,statusCode
|stats count (*) as cantidadReq by rsin_servicio,canal,statusCode,@log
| sort cantidadReq desc
| limit 10000
properties.title: Consumos Canal-Api (RSOUT)

properties.query:
SOURCE logGroups(namePrefix: ["/aws/ecs/srv/PREFIX_VAR"], class: "STANDARD") |
filter @log like /ws-mngr$/
| fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message /\[(?<rquid>[a-f0-9\-]+)\].*\[(?<servicio>\/[^\]]+)\].*\[(?<Paso>[^\[\]]+)\]\[(?<Tiempo>[^\[\]]+)\]$/
| filter ispresent(rquid) and ispresent(Paso) and ispresent(Tiempo) and Tiempo != '-' and Tiempo != 'AuditLog'
| parse Tiempo /(?<TiempoMs>[0-9.]+)/
| stats count(*) as ejecuciones, avg(TiempoMs) as promedio, pct(TiempoMs, 95) as pct95 by Paso
| sort pct95 desc
| limit 100
properties.title: LATENCIA POR PASO ESB
